intro: Accounts at DNS providers, used to prove that you control a domain through DNS (DNS-01). DNS record management will use them too.

dialog.description: Secrets are stored on this server and never shown again.
dialog.stepUp: Saving may ask for your password again.

delete.content: Certificates that validate through this account could then no longer be renewed.

emptyText: Add an account at your DNS provider to issue wildcard certificates, or for servers that port 80 cannot reach.
